title: Stardew Valley Overworld Music
description: This resourcepack replaces a hundred or two overworld musics to stardew valley musics.
body:
This resourcepack replaces 100 or 150 Overworld musics to Stardew Valley musics. Overhauls Minecraft's music system for Stardew fans!

- Replaces 100+ overworld musics to Stardew musics
- Title screen plays "Stardew Overture" every so often just like Stardew Valley
- Stardew musics play depending on biomes and stuff! E.g in caves it plays a few Stardew cave musics! 

**__Note: This is a non-commercial fan-made resource pack created for Minecraft and Stardew Valley fans. I do not claim ownership of the original Stardew Valley music or any related intellectual property. All rights to the original music and assets belong to their respective copyright holders. If you are the rights holder and have any concerns about this project, please contact me and I will address them promptly.__**

**Zeinov's https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stardew-valley-music is much better than mine, credits to Zeinov for inspiration. While mine is a little different and adds 100+ musics, Zeinov's project has musics for nether and end too but mine doesn't. But Zeinov's pack is outdated and mine is Up-to date! I also have another Music Disc resourcepack if you are looking for replacement for music discs.**
